items.title: Keith Jarrett Jasmine tribute and Béatrice Civaton Racines Sonores
items.summary: Two same-day Paris jazz options: an intimate Keith Jarrett and Charlie Haden tribute at JASS Club and Béatrice Civaton's open-ended JazzDeDemain set at Le Baiser Salé.

items.title: MODUS symmetric any-to-any decoding and Gigapixel pixel-space self-play
items.summary: MODUS treats dense visual modalities and language as symmetric decoder outputs without task-specific heads; Gigapixel separates closed-loop interaction learning in simplified perspective simulation from later real-image adaptation.

items.title: Dancing Links
items.summary: A sparse exact-cover matrix is stored as circular doubly linked lists so speculative cover operations can be undone by reversing local pointer updates rather than copying search state.

items.title: Non-reciprocal linearly polarized light in simple processed films
items.summary: Interference between chirality and linear anisotropy produces direction-dependent absorption and emission of orthogonal linear polarizations in solution-processed magic-size-cluster films.

items.title: Turkey's municipal legal battlefield and upstream entry into Kirkuk
items.summary: A new Üsküdar detention illustrates how permits and procurement expose opposition municipalities to centrally controlled legal pressure; TPAO's 15% Kirkuk stake moves Turkey from transit bargaining toward upstream participation.

items.title: Reserve potential is not deliverable oil supply
items.summary: TPAO's equity position is concrete, but resource estimates and pipeline nameplate capacity remain separated from realised exports by investment, contracts, allocation disputes, security and arbitration.

items.title: Marx on revolutions perfecting the inherited state machine
items.summary: The Eighteenth Brumaire passage focuses attention on institutional inheritance: capturing a centralised bureaucratic-executive apparatus can reproduce its separation from society even under a new political programme.

items.title: Pascal on justice and might; Nietzsche on conviction and truth
items.summary: Pascal distinguishes empowering justice from retroactively declaring force just; Nietzsche warns that sincere identity-bound conviction can resist correction more strongly than strategic deception.

items.title: tenir au courant and tenir au jus
items.summary: Neutral, familiar and formal ways to ask for updates, with a warning against the office Franglais mettre dans la loop.

recommendations.piece: Samuel Coleridge-Taylor — Clarinet Quintet in F-sharp minor, Op. 10
recommendations.rating_note: Pretty good, with some particularly strong passages; reminiscent of some Dvořák quartets and quintets.

items.title: Marshallese stick charts model ocean swell structure
items.summary: Rebbelib and mattang charts encoded islands and reflected or refracted swell patterns as training models, while navigators relied on memorised and embodied wave-reading at sea.

items.title: St. Petersburg paradox
items.summary: A coin-toss lottery has unbounded expected monetary value although most outcomes are tiny, forcing a choice among diminishing utility, one-shot risk, finite-bank constraints and alternative decision rules.
